title: SecondU 的产品判断、实现与验证
summary: v0.1.2 已公开发布。v0.1.3 候选新增 144 次合成评测、官网量化摘要与独立报告、Hero 真实 alpha 避让、启动握手修复及独立隐私插图；网站实屏与包内隔离运行已核对，原生最新连续操作及最终发布仍待收尾。外部 Kimi 无有效结果。

stages.title: 确定产品问题
stages.summary: 围绕个人认知如何帮助具体任务研究已有产品和执行框架，保留采用与放弃的理由。
details: 固定研究档案，避免重复拆解。
区分数字分身的持续认知与专家 Agent 的任务能力。
stages.summaryEn: Study how personal understanding supports real tasks, retaining the reasons for adopting or rejecting designs.
detailsEn: Retain a fixed research archive to avoid repeated teardown.
Separate the twin’s enduring understanding from specialists’ task capabilities.

stages.title: 建立最小闭环
stages.summary: 把来源、认知、任务审批、成果版本和反馈接起来，并验证重启后的状态保留。
details: 首版可运行版本有实际本地提交。
历史闭环证据覆盖对应版本，不能自动代表新界面。
stages.summaryEn: Connect sources, context, task approvals, file versions and feedback; verify state after restart.
detailsEn: The initial working version has a real local commit.
Historical checks cover that version, not later interface changes.

stages.title: 完善真实使用路径
stages.summary: 从功能入口转向连续任务，补齐项目、Agent 会话、模型配置、独立中英文示例和远端执行。
stages.summaryEn: Connect projects, Agent conversations, model configuration, independent bilingual examples and remote execution into continuous workflows.

stages.title: 按最新反馈修订

stages.summaryEn: The v0.1.3 evaluation records, portrait and text-glyph clearance, and local startup handshake have scoped evidence. Current native title/collapse checks, the privacy illustration and publication remain pending. External Kimi review has no valid result; final user acceptance is not inferred.

stages.title: 验证并交付本机版本

evidence.title: 首屏动画减负与离屏停机
evidence.titleEn: Hero rendering cost and offscreen suspension
evidence.scope: 同一 Chrome 页面，1124×884 浅色，八秒本机样本
evidence.scopeEn: Same Chrome page, 1124×884 light theme, eight-second local sample
evidence.detail: 保留原 45 Hz 门限约 30 帧、DPR 上限 1.5 与回声顶点减负，撤回实测更慢的 60 Hz 尝试；光晕改静态后整体 59.49 fps、p95 17.4 ms、无超过 50 ms 的整体间隔。Hero 29.87 fps、p95 34.1 ms，仍有两次超过 50 ms；离屏 Hero 绘制为零。结果不保证其他设备、GPU 完成时间或生产冷启动。
evidence.detailEn: Keep the original 45 Hz threshold (about 30 rendered fps), DPR cap 1.5 and echo vertex reduction; the slower measured 60 Hz attempt was reverted. Static washes yielded 59.49 overall fps, p95 17.4 ms and no overall intervals above 50 ms. Hero reached 29.87 fps, p95 34.1 ms, with two intervals above 50 ms; offscreen Hero draws were zero. This does not establish other-device performance, completed GPU work or production cold loading.
